channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: André Mendonça será relator de queixa-crime de Caiado contra Boulos no STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça will serve as rapporteur for the criminal complaint filed by former Goiás governor and PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado against Guilherme Boulos, Minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency in Lula’s government. Caiado alleges Boulos committed slander, defamation, and insult against his honor.

item.title: Coordenador de Lula diz que PL questiona pesquisas por falta de votos
item.description: The coordinator of Lula's campaign in São Paulo, Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, says the PL is desperate due to lack of votes when challenging election polls at the TSE, particularly the Atlas/Bloomberg survey showing Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro. He states that Lula's campaign is not concerned by these actions, viewing them as a recurring attempt to deny reality by a group that adopts anti-science and anti-vaccine positions.

item.title: Tarifaço: nem Lula, nem Flávio querem filho feio
item.description: The text draws an analogy between the sensationalist paternity tests on 1990s American TV and the current Brazilian political debate over the 'tarifaço', suggesting that neither Lula nor Flávio Bolsonaro wants to be associated with an unpopular measure, as if avoiding being labeled the 'father' of a negative outcome. It highlights how both figures are distancing themselves from responsibility for controversial economic decisions.

item.title: Atenções se voltam para eleição
item.description: With Brazil's elimination from the World Cup, attention shifts back to the October municipal election, which is set to dominate conversations in bars and social spaces starting next week. The text implies a return of political focus after the sporting event, suggesting the electoral campaign will regain momentum in public discourse.

item.title: SobeDesce: de Nayib Bukele a Rui Costa
item.description: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele is highlighted as a public security reference and the most popular leader in the Americas with 67% positive image, according to CB Global Data. Meanwhile, Rui Costa had his 2020 accounts for the Northeast Consortium rejected by the TCE due to 'serious errors' in purchasing ventilators during the pandemic. The article also notes BYD's success with the Dolphin model in Brazil's electric vehicle sales, Beyoncé's historic Billboard Hot 100 debut, and controversies involving Brad Pitt, Zahara, Maddox, and Neymar.

item.title: Psicodrama eleitoral
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections are portrayed as an electoral psychodrama, defined by corruption scandals, internal Bolsonarist feuds, institutional gridlock among the Three Powers, and a crisis of public trust. No candidate has presented a sufficiently mobilizing political project, leaving nearly 30% of voters rejecting all major options while remaining unenthusiastic about alternatives. The situation is worsened by public discourse radicalization, fiscal deficit, reliance on refined fuels, and strained Brazil-U.S. relations amid global geopolitical turmoil.

item.title: Permanência com aprendizado
item.description: The text traces the history of Brazil's school incentive programs, from the 1990s Bolsa-Escola and Poupança-Escola to their evolution into Bolsa Família and Pé-de-Meia, emphasizing their role in reducing school dropout rates. However, it critiques the assumption that mere school attendance equals learning, arguing that schools must be enjoyable and useful to truly engage students, preventing both student dropout and institutional disengagement from youth interests. While reduced dropout is positive, it is insufficient without educational quality and relevance to students' lives.

item.title: PL e Flávio acham que não há mais reconciliação com Michelle
item.description: The PL leadership and Flávio Bolsonaro conclude there is no longer any chance of reconciliation with Michelle Bolsonaro before the 2026 elections, viewing the effort as futile after her public statements of rupture. The split removes a key bridge for Flávio to female and evangelical voters, demographics where Michelle had strong influence. According to PoderData/Aya poll, Lula has 45% and Flávio 43% in voting intentions for a potential runoff, technically tied within the margin of error.

item.title: Democracia é irreal no Brasil porque exclui maioria da população
item.description: Lawyer and political scientist Gabriela Rollemberg claims Brazilian democracy is unreal because it excludes the majority of the population, particularly women, who make up 52% of the electorate but hold only 17.7% of congressional seats. She cites the absence of female presidential candidates in 2026 for the first time in 20 years, party amnesties that violate gender and racial quotas, gender-based violence in politics, and the neglect of care policies like childcare and full-time education as key barriers to women's political advancement.

item.title: Só mulheres são capazes de romper a polarização, diz Gabriela Rollemberg
item.description: Lawyer and political scientist Gabriela Rollemberg stated that the female vote will be decisive in the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections and that women are the only force capable of reducing political polarization. She noted that, despite representing 52% of the electorate, women hold only 17.7% of congressional seats due to historical barriers and ineffective enforcement of gender quotas. Rollemberg urged women to scrutinize candidates’ proposals on security, childcare, full-time education, and the care economy.

item.title: Fala de Flávio reforça tese de Michelle, dizem aliados da ex-primeira-dama
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he no longer has a relationship with Michelle Bolsonaro, confirming her prior remarks about her stepson. Allies of the former first lady interpreted this as confirmation of her position. The statement was made amid the 2026 presidential pre-campaign context.

item.title: Articulação por vice isola Flávio e aumenta tensão entre aliados
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's effort to nominate Daniella Marques as his vice-presidential running mate is seen as a dangerous misstep by PL allies and centrist parties, who fear it will isolate the candidate and heighten internal tensions. The choice is criticized for lacking political and strategic alignment, causing friction among supporters. The move is viewed as a threat to ticket cohesion and electoral viability in 2026.

item.title: Bater ou não bater: Dilema de Flávio nas pesquisas impõe desafio a rivais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) presidential campaign in 2026 is facing stagnation in the polls amid a series of crises, creating a strategic dilemma for his rivals on the right and center-right: whether to attack him or not, weighing the risk of energizing his base against fragmenting the opposition. The core question is whether direct confrontation would benefit opponents or inadvertently boost Bolsonarism.

item.title: Ascensão de Trump fez gestão Lula retomar diálogo com os EUA sobre cooperação em defesa e segurança
item.description: The Lula administration sought to resume defense and security cooperation with the United States, even after Trump designated the PCC and CV as terrorist organizations in June 2025. Despite the measure causing tensions and halting correspondence for five days, officials from both countries continued dialogue efforts, including a meeting between Brazilian Defense Minister José Múcio and U.S. Undersecretary of Defense for Policy Elbridge Colby in Peru to discuss narcotics trafficking. The Brazilian government viewed the U.S. measure as a threat to sovereignty but insists on dialogue to advance bilateral agreements.

item.title: Com novo tarifaço de Trump e déficit fiscal crescente, Brasil chega à eleição mais importante do mundo em 2026 sem margem para erro, diz analista
item.description: Global strategist Ruchir Sharma warns that Trump's new tariff hikes and Brazil's rising fiscal deficit create a highly complex scenario for the 2026 elections, leaving little room for error and affecting both foreign investment and the domestic political landscape.

item.title: Flávio recorre a estilo usado por Nikolas para chamar atenção em vídeo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) used a camera-tapping gesture popularized by Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) in a video criticizing the new U.S. tariffs on Brazil and blaming Lula. The tactic, aimed at boosting social media engagement, was acknowledged by Nikolas in the comments. The move comes as allies pressure Flávio to increase his online presence, a domain where Nikolas is seen as a benchmark.

item.title: Lula costura candidaturas ao Senado próximo ao prazo para convenções
item.description: President Lula is coordinating Senate candidacies to strengthen the governing base and prevent an opposition majority in the 2026 elections. In Ceará, he secured Cid Gomes' (PSB) re-election bid, who will run alongside Elmano de Freitas (PT), while his brother Ciro Gomes (PSDB) is expected to run for governor with PL support. In Mato Grosso do Sul, Lula confirmed backing for Senator Soraya Thronicke's (PSB) re-election, who is now allied with Vander Loubet (PT) in the race.

item.title: Celina diz que vai trabalhar para que Michelle Bolsonaro concorra ao Senado
item.description: The governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão (PP), stated she will work to ensure Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) runs for the Senate in 2026, calling her an important asset and poll leader. She also confirmed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) as her presidential candidate, with whom she is allied, and noted Ibaneis Rocha’s (MDB) withdrawal from the Senate race as a personal decision.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: Senado inicia recesso e impõe derrota a calendário de Lula
item.description: Lula's government failed to pass in the Senate the PEC to reduce the workweek from 44 to 40 hours (end of the 6x1), already approved by the Chamber. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre kept the proposal stalled, citing the need for careful deliberation and holding meetings with business and union leaders. The measure, which includes a two-stage transition and wage protection, remains shelved during the parliamentary recess.

item.title: Tarifaço: a conexão Trump-Bolsonaro que custa bilhões ao Brasil
item.description: The United States has imposed a new 25% tariff on Brazilian products including sugarcane ethanol, gasoline, and heavy machinery, allegedly to influence Brazil’s 2026 presidential election in favor of Flávio Bolsonaro. This move, part of Trump’s aggressive trade policy, revives historical tariff conflicts but now carries a clear political-electoral motive. While key Brazilian exports like orange juice, beef, and aircraft were exempted, the measure still inflicts significant economic harm and is widely interpreted as an attempt at foreign interference in Brazil’s democratic process.

item.title: Multa para quem não vota é de R$ 3,51, valor que não é reajustado desde 1993
item.description: The fine for not voting in Brazil has remained at R$ 3.51 per round since 1993, without adjustment, despite inflation raising its equivalent value to approximately R$ 27 today. The Electoral Justice applies fines ranging from R$ 1.05 to R$ 3.51 per round, based on judicial discretion. The lack of updating the penalty raises questions about its effectiveness as a coercive mechanism for voter participation.

item.title: Renan Santos culpa Lula e Flávio por tarifaço de Trump
item.description: Renan Santos, a presidential pre-candidate from the Missão party, accused Lula of 'pushing with his belly' in negotiations to avoid the U.S. tariff hike and called Flávio Bolsonaro 'incompetent' for attending the USTR hearing. He claimed he would have negotiated better, offering rare earths as leverage, and criticized the Brazilian government's absence at the hearings. A 25% additional tariff on Brazilian goods takes effect on July 22, 2026.

item.title: Lula abre R$ 13,3 bi para Desenrola e produtores rurais
item.description: The Lula government issued a provisional measure allocating R$ 13.285 billion in extraordinary credit, with R$ 9 billion directed to agribusiness innovation via FNDCT/Finep, R$ 3 billion to the Desenrola Adimplentes debt relief program, and R$ 1 billion for student financing through Fies. Additional allocations include R$ 270 million for Northeastern sugarcane producers affected by extreme weather and U.S. tariffs, and R$ 15 million for Brazil’s voluntary contribution to the Inter-American Court of Human Rights.

item.title: Impasse do PL em RR e MT trava escolha de Daniella como vice de Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential pre-campaign is considering Daniella Marques (Republicanos), former president of Caixa Econômica Federal, as his vice-presidential running mate, but negotiations are stalled due to the PL's support for Republicanos candidates in Roraima and Mato Grosso. Daniella, who also serves as economic coordinator for the campaign, has been highlighted by Flávio as part of his strategy to improve appeal among female voters, though her nomination remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Fiscalização do TCE vê verbas infladas em contratos de rodovias de SP
item.description: The São Paulo State Court of Accounts (TCE-SP) identified possible inflated values in economic-financial rebalancing contracts of highway concessionaires linked to the Covid-19 pandemic, with a potential financial imbalance of up to R$ 2.5 billion cited by Deputy Antonio Donato (PT). The audit found that Artesp included periods beyond the actual pandemic impact (March 2020–December 2022) and failed to separate light and heavy vehicle traffic, potentially favoring companies. Despite the technical findings, the case was archived by councilor Wagner Rosário, former head of the State Controller's Office under Governor Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Caiado diz que fala de Marco Rubio sobre Lula foi "infeliz"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, a 2026 presidential pre-candidate, called Marco Rubio's statement about Lula "unfortunate," arguing that the 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods harm the population and economy, while also suggesting Lula might be using the episode to bolster a nationalist sovereignty narrative. Caiado criticized the government's inaction in the face of trade barriers from China, the EU, and the U.S., and attacked both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for failing to effectively defend the agribusiness sector.

item.title: Flávio nega foto com “Sicário” e diz que imagem é feita por IA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro denied that a photo showing him alongside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as 'Sicário', is authentic, claiming it was manipulated using artificial intelligence. He criticized President Lula for allegedly lacking familiarity with AI technologies and pointed to visible errors in the image, such as a deformed finger. Flávio’s office stated he never met the person in the photo and suggested it may be AI-generated, despite detection tools finding no signs of manipulation.

item.title: Soraya afirma que Lula confirmou apoio à sua reeleição ao Senado
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) stated that President Lula confirmed his support for her Senate re-election bid in Mato Grosso do Sul, emphasizing the need to increase women's representation in politics. She met with Lula on Thursday (July 16), alongside PSB and PT leaders including Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and PT national president Edinho Silva. Soraya declined an offer to be Vander Loubet’s (PT-MS) running mate, affirming she remains a Senate candidate and will continue collaborating with him to elect two senators from the state.

item.title: Após vídeos de Lula, Flávio aparece malhando em publicação
item.description: Trainer Julio Balestrin posted stories showing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro doing aerobic and weight exercises, following similar videos previously shared by President Lula displaying his gym routine. The posts highlight both pre-candidates' focus on physical fitness ahead of the 2026 presidential race, with Lula having earlier promoted exercise as key to healthy aging.

item.title: Família Bolsonaro traz entraves para exportações do agronegócio
item.description: The political escalation by the Bolsonaro family, particularly the sons' requests for sanctions against Brazil to prevent the former president's imprisonment, is directly impacting Brazilian agribusiness exports, creating commercial barriers with the United States. This diplomatically tense situation, driven by personal judicial motives, has the potential to intensify and further harm the agroexport sector, which is already sensitive to exchange rate fluctuations and non-tariff barriers.

item.title: Flávio propõe IA para ajudar mulheres vítimas de violência doméstica
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) proposed the launch of a virtual assistant named 'MarIA' to support women facing domestic violence and assist with tasks such as opening MEIs, scheduling mammograms, and finding daycare. The tool, designed with voice communication for illiterate women, was unveiled during the 'Brasil Por Elas' initiative launch, which also includes private daycare vouchers, microcredit for entrepreneurship, and chemical castration of rapists. Flávio also advocated for a woman to be his vice-presidential running mate, naming Daniella Marques, Simone Marquetto, and Clarissa Tércio as potential candidates.

item.title: Flávio: “estancar Michelle”? Chamem-se Lacan e Santa Lee ou a Polícia?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used the verb 'estancar' to describe his relationship with Michelle Bolsonaro, prompting interpretations of a veiled threat. The author suggests the term may reflect an unconscious misogynistic lapse, evoking the staunching of blood, or a literal threat, but prefers a psychoanalytic reading involving Lacan and Rita Lee over police intervention.

item.title: FLÁVIO BOLSONARO lança PLANO para MULHERES com DANIELLA MARQUES
item.description: Federal Deputy Flávio Bolsonaro launched a women-focused plan in collaboration with activist Daniella Marques. The initiative aims to strengthen public policies for female empowerment, emphasizing security, health, and access to opportunities. The plan was presented in a video event with calls for social media engagement.

item.title: Flávio diz que tentou barrar tarifaço dos EUA: “Lula cavou pênalti”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) said his team tried to prevent the U.S. from imposing 25% tariffs on Brazilian products, but claimed President Lula 'dug a penalty' and allowed the measure, worsening trade relations with the U.S., China, and the EU. He argued this harms Brazilian meat and protein exports. The remarks were made during the launch of the 'Brasil por Elas' program, focused on public policies for women.

item.title: Lula pede união dos partidos para defender a soberania brasileira
item.description: President Lula called for party unity to defend Brazilian sovereignty amid new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, which Brasília views as a national threat. Diplomatic tensions escalated with mutual criticisms, as the Planalto evaluates retaliatory measures. Lula's relationship with Trump remains strained, marked by a history of confrontations and the recent U.S. designation of Brazilian criminal factions as foreign terrorist organizations.

item.title: Alexandre de Moraes assume presidência do STF nesta sexta
item.description: Alexandre de Moraes will assume the temporary presidency of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) this Friday, the 17th, replacing Edson Fachin, who has held the position since the start of the recess on July 2. The July duty roster is shared between the president and vice-president of the Court, as per institutional routine.

item.title: 'Não virei feministo', diz Flávio ao lançar plano focado em mulheres
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro unveiled a women-focused government plan, stating he 'did not become a feminist'. The initiative aims to reduce his rejection among female voters amid tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula comenta nas redes sociais taxa de Trump: ‘Apontamos que não há justificativa para as tarifas anunciadas’
item.description: President Lula criticized the 25% tariffs imposed by the U.S. on Brazilian goods, stating there is no justification for the measure and defending national sovereignty and the Pix payment system. He emphasized that Brazil will seek dialogue but will not yield in protecting its producers and economic policy instruments. The tariff affects approximately US$7.4 billion in Brazilian exports to the U.S. in 2024, with the government preparing a relief program for impacted sectors.

item.title: Indicado de Trump a embaixador promete defender eleições livres no Brasil
item.description: Donald Trump's nominee for U.S. ambassador to Brazil, Congressman Daniel Perez, stated during a Senate Foreign Relations Committee hearing that he would support free and fair elections in Brazil, protect American citizens, advance U.S. commercial interests, combat drug trafficking and transnational crime, and build economic partnerships. His remarks come amid diplomatic tensions following U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods and reciprocal criticism between the two governments. Trump is also expected to speak about electronic voting machines in Brazil and declassified intelligence related to unsubstantiated claims of fraud in the 2020 U.S. election.

item.title: Flávio diz que foto com Sicário foi manipulada
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president, stated during a live stream with Daniella Marques that a photo showing him alongside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as 'Sicário', was manipulated using artificial intelligence. He denied any association with the individual and claimed the image was a technological forgery. The statement comes amid growing concerns about disinformation and deepfakes in electoral campaigns.

item.title: TSE firma acordos com plataformas para combater desinformação
item.description: The TSE signed memorandums of understanding with digital platforms and AI companies to renew and expand the Permanent Program to Combat Disinformation, aiming to protect the 2026 elections from false narratives threatening electoral integrity and vote legitimacy. The agreements involve seven platforms (Kwai, Telegram, Meta, TikTok, Google, X, LinkedIn) and three AI firms (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Anthropic), focusing on detecting coordinated inauthentic behavior and content moderation, supported by legal guidance from the TSE.

item.title: Marçal faz vídeo de IA simulando terapia com Neymar
item.description: Pablo Marçal posted an AI-generated video simulating a therapy session with Neymar, focusing on the player's emotional essence beyond statistics and trophies, using archival footage and a child holding a ball. The video responds to a viral post depicting Neymar winning the 2030 World Cup, contrasting with Brazil's real 2026 Round of 16 loss to Norway, where Neymar scored the sole Brazilian goal via a late penalty.

item.title: O recado de Lula após EUA anunciarem nova tarifa de 25% ao Brasil
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva posted a message on social media following the U.S. announcement of a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, emphasizing the defense of national sovereignty and stating the government will not waver in protecting it. He stressed the pursuit of dialogue, dismissed U.S. justifications regarding Pix as unfounded, and announced actions including invoking the Reciprocity Law and raising the issue at the WTO. The post included videos and statements from Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira, aligning with a stance of firmness and negotiation.

item.title: “Eu não virei feministo”, diz Flávio ao lançar plano Brasil por Elas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro launched the 'Brasil por Elas' plan, featuring 12 proposals targeting women, including free internet for 70 million women, a Gov.br-linked app, and an artificial intelligence system. During the live broadcast, he stated, 'I did not become a feminist,' to distance himself from ideological labels while presenting the package as a public policy initiative. The plan aims to expand digital and social services access for women, emphasizing inclusion and technology.

item.title: Flávio diz que foto com Sicário foi feita por IA: “Mindinho de 20 cm”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claimed that a photo of him alongside Luiz Phillip Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as 'Sicário', was manipulated by artificial intelligence, pointing to an alleged '20 cm pinky finger' as evidence of forgery. He mocked the absence of a finger on President Lula's left hand, suggesting the AI used to edit the image was 'afraid' to remove more. This claim contrasts with his initial reaction, when he said he did not know if the photo was real and stated he often poses with people without identifying them.

item.title: “O governo brasileiro não vacilará” na defesa da soberania, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil will not waver in defending national sovereignty, in response to the new 25% tariff imposed by the U.S. on Brazilian imports. The comment was made in an Instagram post, emphasizing that protecting sovereignty is an obligation above all interests. The Brazilian government is seeking to respond firmly to U.S. trade measures.

item.title: Tarifaço deve impactar 18% das exportações para os EUA, estima governo
item.description: U.S. tariffs are expected to directly impact 2,400 Brazilian companies accounting for 18% of Brazil’s exports to the United States, valued at $7.4 billion. The most affected sectors include wood, machinery, furniture, ceramics, footwear, and sugar, while meats and coffee were largely spared. The government says it will continue pursuing market diversification, as the U.S. share of Brazilian exports fell from 12.1% to 9.4% in 2026.

item.title: Renan Santos anuncia show de rock gratuito após cancelamento no Rio
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos (Missão) announced a free rock concert by his band, Banda Limão Rosa, at Bar Bukowski in Rio de Janeiro, following the cancellation of a show at Audio Rebel due to pressure from left-wing activists. He denounced the cancellation as authoritarian and ridiculous, insisting the band performs only existential and relationship-themed music, not political acts. The new show will be free, in a larger venue, and he expects a full house.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que defender mulher de covarde e vagabundo é pauta da direita
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, announced he will create the 'Central da Mulher', a public security platform focused on women, if elected. He stated that defending women from cowards and vagabonds is a typical right-wing agenda.

item.title: Flávio volta a defender mulher como vice e cita Daniella Marques, Simone Marchetto e Clarissa Tércio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) reiterated his preference for a female running mate in his 2026 presidential ticket, naming Daniella Marques, Simone Marchetto, and Clarissa Tércio as potential candidates. He also launched the 'Brasil por Elas' program, featuring job apps, childcare vouchers, microcredit for women entrepreneurs, and chemical castration for rapists, while criticizing President Lula for not using a cellphone, calling it emblematic of an analog and disconnected government.
